title: Acyclicity input for coherent sheaf Ext
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]), let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal I$ be an injective $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then the sheaf $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal I)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] is acyclic for global sections: $H^p(X,\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal I))=0$ for every $p>0$.

source.place: Lemma 0FZ3, proof of (1), injective-resolution construction of the local-to-global Ext spectral sequence

proof.text: By [lem-sc-ext-coherent-hom-injective-flasque], the underlying abelian sheaf of $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal I)$ is flasque on the Zariski space of $X$.

source.place: Lemma 0FZ3, proof of (1), the injective-resolution input to the local-to-global Ext spectral sequence

proof.text: The flasque acyclicity theorem [lem-sc-zariski-flasque-acyclic] gives $H^p(X_{\rm Zar},\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal I)_{\mathrm{ab}})=0$ for every $p>0$.

source.place: Lemma 0FZ3, proof of (1), the injective-resolution input to the local-to-global Ext spectral sequence

proof.text: By the module/abelian Zariski cohomology comparison [lem-sc-module-abelian-zariski-cohomology], the module cohomology $H^p(X,\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal I))$ is canonically the same group as the underlying abelian Zariski cohomology in Step 2. Hence it is zero for every $p>0$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03FD, specialized to the small Zariski site
